result.summary: Replaced 5-min cron-refreshed materialized view with real-time trigger-driven inventory_balances table. Created migration 20260531085754_realtime_inventory_balances.sql that: (1) drops the cron schedule, (2) drops the materialized view, (3) creates inventory_balances as a real table with same schema, (4) creates refresh_inventory_balance() function that recalculates per-part from inventory_movements, (5) adds unified AFTER INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE trigger on inventory_movements, (6) seeds initial data from existing movements. Applied migration to remote Supabase, regenerated TypeScript types (inventory_balances now under Tables, not Views). Service code unchanged — getInventoryBalances works identically against the new table. Build passes.
